description: Rule rates and style profile of research articles in flagship journals and their major sub-journals. Built by calibrate.py; statistics only.

method.selection: First DOI on pages 1-2 (or in the file name) matched to the journal list in calibrate.py; supplements, author manuscripts and duplicates removed.
method.cleaning: pdftotext; reference lists, back matter, running heads, captions, panels and superscript citation numbers removed; only complete sentences kept.
method.research_article: Has a Methods heading and a Results or Discussion heading; reviews excluded.
method.metrics: Per-paper values; quantiles across papers. Rule rates are pooled per 10 000 words.
